html:
Agents,

A patch is being released for iOS which will address a few different issues. (We are working flat out to get a patch for iOS).

This patch will fix the following issues. 

1: Fixed an issue with Silk's 6★ Skill "The Yo-Yo" not pulling enemies correctly.
2: Fixed an issue with Alliance Buffs not applying to Alliance Battle. 
3: Fixed an issue with Team-up Play Inventory issues after pressing the continue button 
4: Fixed an issue with ISO-8 tab button in Hero Information showing an orange dot in wrong situations
5: Fixed an issue where the back button would exit to lobby in S.H.I.E.L.D. lab
6: Fixed an issue with Captain Marvel's 6★ Skill "Radiant Form" where she did not get the effect of her passive and an inability to call strikers
7: Word Censoring in chat changed. 
8: Error [Invalid Response] has been fixed. 
9: Fixed an issue with the app force closing when disconnecting from wifi

We are still working flat out to resume normal Service.
